Sanders Sounds Alarm Over AI Risks
On Saturday, in a post on
, Sanders warned that powerful technology companies were preparing for a potential AI catastrophe while continuing to develop increasingly advanced systems.
"Big Tech oligarchs are secretly preparing for a ‘catastrophic AI event’ that could threaten our banking, healthcare, internet, electricity and water systems," he wrote.
He argued that technology companies were racing to build systems they might not be able to control, raising concerns about the potential consequences for society.
"They’re racing to build a technology they can’t control and that threatens humanity," Sanders wrote.
The senator called on lawmakers to intervene, concluding his post with a direct demand: "CONGRESS MUST PAUSE ADVANCED AI DEVELOPMENT NOW."
